title: FabricCraft Vanilla Survival
description: FabricCraft is a raw, player-driven survival server running on Fabric for true vanilla mechanics. No world resets, no land claiming.
body:
FabricCraft is a vanilla semi-anarchy survival server running on Fabric for real vanilla mechanics.

There are no land claims and no world resets, so the world stays persistent and player driven: alliances, trade, rivalries, and raids.

   * Fabric = true vanilla mechanics (farm/redstone friendly)
   * Semi-anarchy survival with minimal rules, maximum agency.
   * No claims, no resets (persistent world)
   * Player politics, raids, and alliances.
   * No hacked clients or mods that give you an advantage over other players.
   * Simple voice chat mod available server wide.
   * Ban on griefing within 1k of spawn, enforced through active moderation rather than claims.

Almost all SMP servers claim “vanilla” but run Paper/Spigot and end up breaking or nerfing farms and redstone. FabricCraft doesn’t. Your contraptions work the way you expect.

We also have a creative world with no restrictions on how much space you have to build and no plots! Many of our players use this as a testbed to test out builds before building them in the main survival server.

If you are into speedrunning, we have a manhunt gamemode you can play to unlock your inner Dream.
